Another thing us Filipinos love is our garlic.
Boy Bawang literally translates as Boy Garlic,
and this classic Filipino snack is a staple for
pulutan
,
or
snacks
that
people
usually
eat
while
drinking.
As
you
know,
I
don’t
drink,
but I reach for Boy Bawang whenever I crave
something
salty
and
garlicky.
As
a
warning
so
you
don’t
get
surprised:
you’ll
find
real
garlic
chips
in
it
and
they
are
very
sharply
salty and garlicky — almost too strong for

even me. So try them if you wish (I

sometimes think they’re still good

depending on my mood!), but take it

slow and have water with you.
